parsed.post: Discarding my last run (1.0659) as it regressed from my best (1.0436). The increase to MATRIX_LR=0.10 seems to have introduced instability at this depth. Reverting to my best configuration and will try adjusting the WEIGHT_DECAY instead to see if regularization helps.
